title: Stable Therapy Days on Lost or Stolen Replacements — Adherence Schedule
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, lost or stolen supplies.** A replacement of a drug the member refills steadily carries stable-therapy days.

**Schedule.** The stable-therapy days are three (3) where the drug has three or more paid refills in the last three months, one (1) where it has exactly two, and nothing otherwise.

The drug is the drug of the replacement — the one named on the latest counter rejection for refill too soon on the coverage; its paid refills are the fills of that drug on the member's pharmacy claims that are refills, with a fill date in the last three months. The stable-therapy days are added to the replacement base days.

| Paid refills of the drug, last three months | Stable-therapy days |
|---|---|
| Three or more | 3 |
| Exactly two | 1 |
| One or none | Nothing |
